architectural_notes: Meeting type terminology should be consistent across UI: replace "Weekday" with "Mid-week" everywhere it appears (including modal options, statistics labels, and record cards).

existing_features.title: In the Record Attendance modal meeting type dropdown, replace the option label and stored value "Weekday Meeting" with "Mid-week Meeting", while keeping the "Weekend Meeting" option unchanged.
In the attendance statistics summary UI, change the user-facing label text from "Average weekday attendance" to "Average mid-week attendance".
In the meeting attendance record cards list, replace the displayed meeting type text "Weekday Meeting" with "Mid-week Meeting" wherever it appears.

Update any other user-facing UI text across the frontend that contains "Weekday" to use "Mid-week" instead, and ensure attendance statistics calculations continue to correctly classify existing stored records that may still contain "Weekday" as mid-week records.

new_feature_requests.summary: Rename meeting type terminology from "Weekday" to "Mid-week" across the app (Record Attendance modal dropdown, statistics labels, record cards, and any other occurrences)
